content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I am reviewing the agreement and wanted to suggest a couple of adjustments before we sign. - Intellectual property ownership transfers to the Client immediately upon creation or via present assignment before you are guaranteed full payment; I propose changing the relevant clause so that upon full payment of all fees due for the applicable deliverables, all right, title, and interest in such deliverables shall be assigned to the Client. - Your indemnification obligations and claims related to intellectual property and confidential information are carved out of the liability cap, exposing you to unlimited financial liability for those claims; I propose modifying the agreement so that notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, each party's total liability in respect of damages under this Agreement, any regulation or common law shall be limited to the sum of all amounts received from Client in terms of this Agreement. Thank you and best regards.
